arguments.need: I run Claude Code and Codex side by side on the same repo and want one to write code while the other reviews it, passing messages back and forth. I also want them to remember project decisions and where we left off between sessions. It needs to keep everything in a local file on my machine, not need a separate AI model, and be open source.
